guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: A quick guide to the main features of the app.
gettingStarted: Pick a project at the top of the home screen.
Press play to start a work shift; the timer runs while you work.
Use pause for a break and stop to end the shift.
shifts: Shifts can start automatically when you enter a project's area (if the project has a location).
Open Work shifts to see your history by day and month.
Select days and export a report as PDF or Excel.
tasks: Open Tasks to see what's assigned to you and your projects.
Create a task with a title, dates and an assignee.
Set reminders so you don't miss a deadline.
Mark a task complete when it's done.
projects: Browse your projects and open one to see its tasks, workers and documents.
Admins can create projects and assign workers.
The home tiles show the next task and project deadlines.
communication: Use Chats to message your team.
Add photos from Camera and files under Documents.
Change the app language under Language.

legal.title: Legal & Policies
legal.heroText: Your privacy is important to us. Bygg App is committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring transparency in how your information is collected, used, and stored.
collected: Personal information provided during registration (name, phone number, email)
Work-related data such as time logs, project details, and GPS locations (only during working hours, as configured by your employer)
Communication and documents exchanged within the app
legal.usageTitle: How do we use your data?
usage: To provide and improve our services
To facilitate communication and project management between office, foremen, and workers
To comply with legal obligations and improve security
protection: Your data is securely stored both locally and in the cloud
Access is protected by login/password and other secure authentication methods
We do not share your personal information with third parties except as required by law or with your consent
rights: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time
You can contact our support team regarding privacy questions or data removal requests
notice: By using Bygg App, you agree to our Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy
For more information, please review the full documents available in the app or on our website
legal.contactText: For any privacy-related questions, please contact us using the details below.

about.title: About the App
about.intro: Bygg App is a modern solution for construction project management and work hour tracking on construction sites.
features: Track working hours both manually and automatically using GPS
Receive and send drawings, tasks, and important documents between the office, foremen, and workers
Manage projects efficiently, receive timely notifications about new tasks, changes, and possible violations on site
Ensure transparency and control over all construction site activities
about.security: Bygg App is available for Android and iOS, protected by modern authentication methods, and fully complies with privacy and data security standards.
about.contact: If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact our support team through the settings menu.

1.title: Time tracking, no hassle
1.f1: Automatic or manual work-time logging — no more filling in timesheets or sending texts.

2.title: Miss nothing, find everything
2.f1: Tasks with automatic reminders — they won't let you forget what matters.
2.f2: All project documents in one place — no more searching for lost drawings.

3.title: Photos that handle themselves
3.f1: Job and receipt photos from the shift attach to the project automatically and show up instantly in the system — take the photo and forget it.
3.f2: Receipt photos are scanned and counted into the project's economy automatically.

1.title: Get your team started
1.f1: Create projects and add staff — they instantly get an email with login and app download.
1.f2: Real-time overview — see who started a shift, who's absent and where.

2.title: Run the work
2.f1: Tasks with reminders — assign to everyone, selected people or one; reminders until it's done.
2.f2: Job and receipt photos attach to the project automatically.

3.title: Money & economy
3.f1: Receipts are scanned and counted into the project's economy automatically.
3.f2: Project economy live — straight from your phone.
3.f3: Export work time to Excel or straight into an invoice/payroll in a couple of clicks.
